unload.detail: Tots els canvis no desats es perdran.
ai-close.message: AI is still generating a response
ai-close.detail: The current task has not finished yet. Closing the window now will interrupt the AI output.
permission.audio-denied-description: L'aplicació no podrà gravar sons ni detectar el so.
permission.video-denied-description: L'aplicació no podrà fer fotos ni utilitzar la detecció de vídeo.
permission.macos-instructions: Per canviar els permisos, obre Preferències del sistema > Seguretat i privadesa > Privadesa > Càmera o micròfon.
crash.title: Crashed/Error fatal
arm-translation.title: Si us plau, baixeu la versió per a ARM enlloc.
arm-translation.message: Esteu utilitzant {APP_NAME} en una capa de traducció, com ara Apple Rosetta. Si us plau, instal·leu la versió nativa d'ARM, ja que tindrà un millor rendiment i farà servir menys bateria.
unnecessary-legacy.title: Please don't use the legacy version
unnecessary-legacy.message: You are using the 'Legacy' version of {APP_NAME} on a device that doesn't need to. This is insecure, slower, and may PERMANENTLY delete your settings and backpack. Please install the normal version instead.
contact-us.title: Contact Us
desktop-settings.title: Configuració de l'escriptori
desktop-settings.update-checker-not-allo: Les actualitzacions es gestionen des de la botiga on heu instal·lat l'aplicació.
desktop-settings.notify-never: No m'aviseu mai de les actualitzacions
desktop-settings.disabled-updates: No és recomanable desactivar el verificador d'actualitzacions, ja que no se us avisarà sobre les actualitzacions de seguretat.
desktop-settings.editor-must-be-open: Error: Obriu l'editor per configurar els dispositius
desktop-settings.media-devices-changed: És possible que hàgiu de reiniciar l'aplicació perquè els canvis de micròfon o de càmera s'apliquin.
desktop-settings.hardware-acceleration-w: Use graphics acceleration when available (requires restart)
desktop-settings.hardware-acceleration-d: Disabling graphics acceleration significantly reduces performance. Some projects can run over 100x slower as all rendering will be done by your CPU. This should only be done as a last resort if graphics acceleration is causing crashes.
desktop-settings.background-throttling-d: Permetre que les finestres ocultes es mantinguin actives donarà lloc a un ús més alt de la CPU i una durada de la bateria més curta.
desktop-settings.bypass-cors: Permet a les extensions accedir a qualsevol lloc web
desktop-settings.bypass-cors-enabled: Això desactivarà diverses característiques de seguretat web dissenyades per protegir-vos. Els projectes o les extensions malicioses podrien accedir a qualsevol lloc web o dispositiu de la vostra xarxa.
desktop-settings.exit-fullscreen-on-esca: Exit F11 fullscreen mode (not the fullscreen button in the editor) when pressing escape
desktop-settings.rich-presence-unavailab: Rich Presence is not available in this version of the app
desktop-settings.top-bar-device-stats: Show device usage in top bar
desktop-settings.top-bar-device-stats-de: Display the CPU and memory usage indicator in the editor's top bar. Toggles apply immediately and the bar re-centers automatically
desktop-settings.context-menu-glass: Frosted glass effect in context menus
desktop-settings.context-menu-glass-desc: Show the editor's right-click menu with a translucent blurred background. Toggles apply immediately without restarting
desktop-settings.check-for-updates-desc: Manually check for the latest version
desktop-settings.no-update: You are using the latest version!
desktop-settings.language-desc: Choose the language used by the NeoWarp interface. Takes effect immediately.
desktop-settings.assoc-sb3-desc: Open Scratch projects in NeoWarp when double-clicked
desktop-settings.assoc-js-desc: Open NeoWarp JavaScript extensions in NeoWarp when double-clicked
desktop-settings.associations-note: Changes apply immediately. If another app is currently the default for these files, Windows may ask which app to use the next time you open one.
desktop-settings.associations-unsupporte: File associations can only be managed on Windows.
desktop-settings.ui-theme-desc: Applies to the editor, SOLO and tool windows
desktop-settings.toolbar-height-desc: Height of the editor's top toolbar. Narrow fits more of the project on screen
desktop-settings.compact-window-style-de: Merge the minimize/maximize/close buttons into the editor's top toolbar. Only affects the editor window
desktop-settings.home-logo-desc: The logo on the left side of the home page. Use an image or custom HTML
desktop-settings.home-text-desc: The text below the logo. Leave empty for the default
desktop-settings.home-reset-desc: Restore the default home page logo, title text and background
desktop-settings.home-background-desc: A custom background image for the home page. Buttons switch to a liquid glass style
desktop-settings.show-recent-projects-de: Show recently opened Scratch and extension projects below the buttons on the home page
migrate.title: S'està finalitzant l'actualització...
migrate.description: Això és només procés puntual que pot trigar uns moments.
migrate.error: There was an error finishing this update. Some data may not have transferred correctly. Send a screenshot of this window to:
migrate.timed-out: Aquest procés està trigant més temps del compte. Si el progrés no avança, envieu una captura de pantalla d'aquesta finestra a:
migrate.renderer-gone: Updating process crashed (reason: {reason}, code: {code}). Some data may not have transferred correctly. Please send a screenshot of this window to:
migrate.continue-anyways-afterword: If any of your data is missing, please contact us at {email}.
migrate.transfer-editor: Transferint les dades de la motxilla i els complements...
downgrade-warning.title: Downgrading is not supported
downgrade-warning.message:
You are using an older version of {APP_NAME} after using a later version. Please exit and download the latest version from {website}.

If you continue, it is VERY LIKELY that you will PERMANENTLY lose all of your settings and backpack. We WILL NOT be able to recover your data.

(Debug info: {debugInfo})

security-prompt.title: Seguretat de l'Extensió
security-prompt.read-clipboard1: El projecte vol llegir les dades del vostre porta-retalls.
security-prompt.read-clipboard2: Si el vostre porta-retalls conté dades com ara contrasenyes, és possible que el projecte les comparteixi amb altres persones o servidors.
security-prompt.read-clipboard3: És possible que l'accés al porta-retalls no funcioni en alguns sistemes. Si es permet, es permetran automàticament futures lectures del porta-retalls.
security-prompt.notifications2: Si es permet, és possible que el vostre sistema operatiu us demani que habiliteu les notificacions, i es permetran automàticament més notificacions.
unsafe-path.title: Invalid File Location
unsafe-path.details: The file you selected ({file}) is in a folder used internally by {APP_NAME}. It is not safe to save projects here as they can be deleted when the app updates. You must choose a different folder.
